name: app-dark-purple-ai-assistant-with-waveform-and-chat
title: AI assistant screens in black-violet with a pink-purple waveform and generated images
whatItIs: Three dark phone screens on lavender: a home with a mascot robot upgrade card, action tiles and history list; a voice screen with a glowing magenta-violet waveform and prompt text; and a chat showing a request and two generated mountain images with copy and like icons.
whatItMeans: Futuristic and friendly; the waveform makes voice tangible and the violet glow feels creative.
techniques: Render voice as a glowing multi-colour waveform.
Use a gradient pill button as the main action.
Show generated results in bordered chat bubbles.

vocabulary.definition: A graphic of a sound wave.
A chat bubble containing generated media.
A suggested prompt shown as a pill.
A capsule button filled with a gradient.
